result.name: Ringgo Paul
result.rules: 2014 Rogue and Tiefling; ignore 2024 weapon mastery labels on export
result.sourceStatus: Approved level 4 · Piercer; HP d8 roll 3; Tasha’s Cauldron of Everything; 2014 Rogue

attacks.name: Rapier
attacks.effect: Finesse; Sneak Attack may add 2d6 once per turn.

attacks.name: Second dagger
attacks.effect: Two-weapon fighting; no Dexterity modifier to damage.

attacks.name: Sneak Attack
attacks.effect: Add to a qualifying finesse or ranged hit; check ally/advantage and no disadvantage.

actions.name: Cunning Action: Dash
actions.effect: Move up to your speed again this turn.

actions.name: Cunning Action: Disengage
actions.effect: Movement this turn does not provoke opportunity attacks.

actions.name: Cunning Action: Hide
actions.effect: Attempt to hide if the circumstances allow it.

actions.name: Thaumaturgy
actions.effect: Tiefling cantrip: create a minor supernatural sign within 30 feet; no slot.

actions.name: Hellish Rebuke
actions.effect: Once per long rest as a 2nd-level spell, after a creature you can see within 60 feet damages you. Dexterity save DC 14 for half fire damage.

actions.name: Assassinate
actions.effect: Advantage against any creature that has not yet taken a turn in this combat. A hit against a surprised creature is a critical hit.

actions.name: Piercer: reroll damage
actions.type: Once per turn on a hit
actions.effect: After a piercing hit, reroll one damage die from that attack; use the new roll. A piercing Sneak Attack die also qualifies.

actions.name: Piercer: critical hit
actions.effect: Add one extra weapon damage die: rapier +1d8, shortbow +1d6, or dagger +1d4. This extra die is not doubled.

spells.name: Hellish Rebuke
spells.notes: Tiefling Infernal Legacy at character level 3: cast once per long rest as a 2nd-level spell; Dexterity save DC 14, 3d10 fire.

equipment.name: Piton
equipment.notes: The current sheet says piton, not potion.

features.name: Sneak Attack
features.text: 2d6 once per turn on a qualifying finesse or ranged hit.

features.name: Cunning Action
features.text: Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a bonus action on each of your turns.

features.name: Expertise
features.text: Stealth and Investigation. Investigation is the DM-confirmed second choice after this export.

features.name: Hellish Resistance
features.text: Resistance to fire damage.

features.name: Infernal Legacy
features.text: Thaumaturgy cantrip and Hellish Rebuke once per long rest as a 2nd-level spell at this level.

features.name: Assassinate
features.text: Advantage on attacks against creatures that have not taken a turn yet; a hit against a surprised target is a critical hit.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.text: Disguise kit and poisoner’s kit from Assassin archetype.

features.name: Training
features.text: Light armor; simple weapons, hand crossbow, longsword, rapier, shortsword; thieves’ tools, playing cards, land vehicles.

features.name: Piercer
features.text: DEX +1 (now 20). Once per turn on a piercing hit, reroll one damage die from the attack and use the new roll. On a piercing critical hit, add one extra weapon damage die.
features.source: Tasha’s Cauldron of Everything · feat (2014 rules)

features.name: Uncanny Dodge
features.text: Reaction halve damage from visible attacker on qualifying hit
